hook: Trainer plane *force-lands* on Army ground, both on board safe
hook_b: Trainer plane *force-lands* on Army ground, both on board safe
tldr: A two-seater training aircraft of the Telangana State Aviation Academy force-landed on an Army parade ground in Hyderabad on Thursday, November 26; the instructor and trainee were unhurt.

beats.what: The two-seater force-landed on an Army parade ground in Golconda Cantonment on Thursday.
beats.why: A senior official said the aircraft had a power issue and landed following procedure.
beats.care: Training flights operate over the city; no one on board or on the ground was reported hurt.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The aircraft belongs to the Telangana State Aviation Academy.

cards.q: Should flight-training routes over the city be reviewed after this?

qs: How often do training aircraft have to force-land in Telangana?

facts.t: *2* people on board, an instructor and a trainee, were unhurt.

steps.e: Two-seater trainer develops a power issue
Force-lands on Army parade ground per procedure

viz.verdict: A safe outcome; the cause has been described only as a power issue.

watch: Any inquiry findings from the aviation academy or regulators.
